methods.name: list
methods.doc: Read all visible Session rows without resuming an Agent.

methods.name: search
methods.doc: Search visible Session content without resuming an Agent. A non-owner receives only the hits whose Session `allows()` admits; `hasMore` describes the bounded result before that filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Create one ordinary Session for a new conversation, reusing the named blank Session while it is reusable.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.doc: Select one Session-local model after explicitly resuming the Session; save the default in the background.

methods.name: initializeDefaultModel
methods.doc: Select the first available account model after login when no provider API key is configured.

methods.name: modelCatalog
methods.doc: Describe every currently routable model for Host-generation selectors.

methods.name: canOpenWorkspacePath
methods.doc: Report whether this deployment can hand a Session workspace path to a native desktop.

methods.name: openWorkspacePath
methods.doc: Verify one path through the composed filesystem and open it on the Host desktop.

methods.name: workspacePathApplications
methods.doc: Query current file handlers on the serving desktop without activating an Agent.

methods.name: rename
methods.doc: Rename one Session after explicitly resuming it.

methods.name: fork
methods.doc: Fork one cold-readable exact event prefix into a new Session. An omitted boundary selects the latest completed-turn prefix; an open cut receives synthetic fork closers.

methods.name: prompt
methods.doc: Admit one prompt after explicitly resuming its Session.

methods.name: attachment
methods.doc: Read one image proven reachable from the addressed Session log.

methods.name: updateQueue
methods.doc: Mutate one still-pending queue occurrence, resuming a cold Agent first.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Cancel one active Agent turn without dropping its pending inbox.

methods.name: page
methods.doc: Read one cold-safe, message-aligned Session history page.

methods.name: follow
methods.doc: Follow one Session log from its opening or resume cursor.

methods.name: projections
methods.doc: Read exact projections, returning cached hints only when migration is required.

methods.name: control
methods.doc: Stream a complete live-control baseline followed by replacement frames.

props.name: maxImageDimension
props.doc: Maximum intrinsic width and maximum intrinsic height in pixels for one image.

ImageAttachmentLimits.doc: Deployment-resolved limits used by upload admission and request buffering.

props.name: attachmentId
props.doc: Opaque storage identifier; never a filesystem path or bearer URL.

props.name: mediaType
props.doc: Media type verified from the stored bytes.

props.name: bytes
props.doc: Exact encoded byte length.

props.name: width
props.doc: Intrinsic encoded width in pixels.

props.name: height
props.doc: Intrinsic encoded height in pixels.

props.name: name
props.doc: Optional display name stripped of local path information.

props.name: originalDimensions
props.doc: Input dimensions after applying EXIF orientation and before normalization scaling. Present only when normalization reduced the image.

ImageAttachmentRef.doc: Durable, serializable reference to one immutable normalized image.

ImageMediaType.doc: Raster image formats accepted by the version-one attachment path.

InboxWireState.doc: Wire-JSON pending Inbox value. Each message round-trips the session log losslessly, but the fold state's full `UserMessage` type cannot cross a typert Remote boundary (its source union carries an `unknown` replay field), so the typed projection table keeps this JSON-safe form.

props.name: routableProviders
props.doc: Provider routes with at least one currently available catalog model.

ModelCatalog.doc: Host-generation model catalog and the default used by unconfigured Sessions.

ModelCatalogFailure.doc: One provider whose model catalog lookup failed.

ModelCatalogModel.doc: One model displayed inside its provider group.

ModelProviderGroup.doc: One provider and its successfully loaded model catalog.

ModelReasoning.doc: Selectable reasoning metadata for one exact model route.

ModelReasoningEffort.doc: One adapter-owned reasoning effort for an exact model route.

ModelSelection.doc: Complete model selection for one Session.

props.name: lastUsed
props.doc: Selection consumed by the latest recorded model request.

props.name: next
props.doc: Selection the next request should use, falling back to {@link lastUsed}.

ModelSelectionProjection.doc: Client view of the durable model-selection fold.

props.name: id
props.doc: OS application identifier; callers must revalidate it against the file's current handlers before opening.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PNG or SVG data URL, or null when the desktop supplies no icon.

NativeFileApplication.doc: One OS-registered application capable of opening the requested file.

props.name: currentValue
props.doc: The effective current value: a configured preset key, `auto`, or `custom`.

PermissionSelection.doc: Whole `permissions` Session projection: current durable selection only.

PromptContentPart.doc: Browser-submitted prompt content; the Host promotes image bytes to durable references. File parts carry the opaque receipt returned by a preceding `uploadFile` call on the same Session.

props.name: content
props.doc: Non-empty text-only replacement content.

QueueAction.doc: One client-requested mutation of a still-pending queue item.

SessionAddress.doc: Durable identity selecting an ordinary Session or one direct subagent child.

props.name: startedAfterSeq

props.name: nextIndex
props.doc: Dense position expected for the next live chunk frame.

props.name: stream

SessionAssistantStreamAttempt.doc: One active assistant attempt in a reconnect opening snapshot.

SessionAssistantStreamBaseline.doc: Complete process-local assistant state at one follow opening.

props.name: index
props.doc: Number of chunk frames represented by this terminal marker.

SessionAssistantStreamFrame.doc: Browser wire form of one process-local assistant frame.

SessionCancelValue.doc: Receipt after cancellation is admitted to the live Agent.

SessionControlBaseline.doc: Complete live control baseline emitted once per control stream generation.

SessionControlFrame.doc: Host-wide live state stream. Each generation starts with exactly one baseline.

SessionCreateRequest.doc: Request for a Session for a new conversation.

props.name: agentPreset
props.doc: Preset the Session runs, when the deployment composes a preset roster.

SessionEventEntry.doc: One raw Session event in the Remote journal.

SessionFollowFrame.doc: Complete opening window followed by ordered durable events and opted-in assistant frames.

SessionOpenWorkspacePathValue.doc: Confirmation that the Host handed a workspace path to its native opener.

SessionPage.doc: One contiguous backwards page of a Session log.

props.name: throughSeq
props.doc: Inclusive log cut obtained from the corresponding follow opening frame.

props.name: turnWindow
minMessages
props.doc: Minimum append-origin user/assistant messages; must not exceed maxMessages.

props.name: minTurns
props.doc: Minimum Turn starts crossed, including the partial Turn at beforeSeq.
Stop at a Turn start after both minima, unless maxMessages or history exhaustion wins.

props.name: values
props.doc: Provider-validated values; omitted keys are absent capabilities at this cut.

SessionProjectionBaseline.doc: Complete projection values at an exact Session event cursor.

props.name: kind
props.doc: `sequenced`: the Host's live registry produced the block for an attached Session, so `asOfSeq` is comparable with baselines and frames of the same connection. `cached`: a header-only listing viewed the block from the persisted projection cache, so `asOfSeq` is the stored record's own watermark and must not be compared with the connected Session's values.

props.name: asOfSeq
props.doc: Watermark of the block in the sequence space named by `kind`.

props.name: values
props.doc: Provider-validated values present in the block; omitted keys remain unknown.

SessionProjectionHints.doc: Every available wire value a Session-list row carries as partial, possibly stale hints. `kind` and `asOfSeq` are independent facts: `kind` says which sequence space `asOfSeq` belongs to, and therefore how a client may merge the block; `asOfSeq` is the producer's watermark in that space.

props.name: inbox
props.doc: Pending agent input reconstructed from durable inbox splices.

props.name: title
props.doc: The session's current normalized title — the latest `session/title` event's text (last-wins), or `null` before the first title lands. A plain string: the shape the client list rows consume.

props.name: workingDirectory
props.doc: Recorded current directory for Session observations, or null when none is recorded.

props.name: todos
props.doc: The agent's current whole todo list (the latest `todo/write` snapshot), or `null` before the first write. Whole-value rule: every `todo/write` carries the complete replacement list, so the fold is last-wins.

props.name: agentPreset
props.doc: Preset the Session runs, or null when the deployment composes none.

props.name: sessionListMetadata
props.doc: Persisted facts used to summarize a Session without activating it.

props.name: imageLimits
props.doc: Image-intake limits enforced by the Session prompt endpoint.

props.name: modelSelection
props.doc: Durable model selection already used and selected for the next request.

props.name: permissions
props.doc: The session's current permission, folded from the three whole-value knob events (`permission/preset`, `sandbox/mode`, `approval/policy`) over the composition defaults. Selectable options come from the process-level catalog Remote. Key absence means no permission service is composed — clients hide the control.

props.name: subagentCatalog
props.doc: Direct children in parent catalog event order, excluding fork-inherited facts.

props.name: subagentTiming
props.doc: Active-turn duration and latest closed-turn completion for a descriptor-backed subagent session.

props.name: subagent
mode
props.doc: A terminal one-shot child.

props.name: label
props.doc: Optional durable creation label from the child's descriptor.

props.name: seq
props.doc: Seq of the `subagent/descriptor` event this identity was folded from. `session.isOwnSeq(seq)` proves the identity comes from the child's OWN log suffix — where a descriptor is immutable once appended — and not from a fork seed's replayed ancestor descriptor.

props.name: mode
props.doc: A resumable conversation.

props.name: label
props.doc: Durable creation label from the child's descriptor.

props.name: seq
props.doc: Seq of the folded descriptor event; see the one-shot arm for the own-suffix proof.

Identity of a descriptor-backed subagent session. `null` ⟺ no valid descriptor (missing, malformed, or unrecognized-version — deliberately undistinguished). The sentinel is deliberately serializable: a value pushed over JSON transports must survive `JSON.stringify` losslessly, where an `undefined` field would be dropped and a stale identity would survive on the receiving side. The entry itself stays non-optional.

SessionProjectionValues.doc: Typed known projections plus JSON-safe values contributed outside this compilation face.

props.name: values
props.doc: Provider-validated values; omitted keys are absent capabilities at this cut.

SessionProjectionsValue.doc: Exact projections carry their event cut; required migration returns sequence-free cache hints. Null means absent.

props.name: requestId
props.doc: Client-minted identity persisted on the exact accepted user message.

props.name: content
props.doc: At least one non-whitespace text part or attachment.

SessionPromptValue.doc: Receipt after one prompt enters the target Agent inbox.

SessionRenameValue.doc: Normalized title and the durable event position that committed it.

SessionSelectModelValue.doc: Accepted model selection after Host resolution.

props.name: agentAvailable
props.doc: Whether this Session currently owns a live Agent.

props.name: formatStatus
props.doc: Current for attached Sessions; otherwise the persistence format status when reported.

SessionUpdateQueueValue.doc: Receipt after one pending queue mutation commits.

props.name: sourceEventSeqs
props.doc: Earlier sources on current surface events; opaque JSON on unknown ignorable events.

props.name: surfaceOp
props.doc: Canonical placement on current surface events; opaque JSON on unknown ignorable events.

props.name: isSeeded
props.doc: Whether the Session contains a fork-inherited prefix.

SessionWireHeader.doc: Current logical Session metadata carried on the browser wire.

SubagentCatalogEntry.doc: One current direct-child discovery row materialized from parent facts.

props.name: settledMs
props.doc: Milliseconds accumulated across completed turns after the child's own descriptor.

props.name: active
since
props.doc: Start of the open turn.

props.name: through
props.doc: Latest event time folded into this projection cut.
Same-cut bounds of the currently open turn, when one has not reached `turn/end`.

props.name: lastTurnCompleted
props.doc: Whether the latest closed turn after the child's own descriptor completed normally; absent while a turn is open or before one closes.

SubagentTimingProjection.doc: Durable active-turn timing for one descriptor-backed child session.

TextBlock.doc: Plain text visible to the end user.

props.name: content
props.doc: What this task is — a short imperative line shown in the UI.

props.name: status
props.doc: Lifecycle state. `in_progress` marks a task being worked now; parallel work may mark several.

TodoItem.doc: One entry in an agent's todo list — the unit of the `todo/write` whole-list snapshot declared by this package. Deliberately minimal: a human-readable `content` line and a three-state `status`. No id, priority, or `activeForm` — the list is replaced wholesale on every write (last-write-wins), so entries need no stable identity. The three statuses describe the complete portable lifecycle needed by model and UI consumers.
